_about: Kept-undo sentences, built by the backend (services/moodboard_edits.py: one line per kept slice) and by the Studio (components/moodboard-studio/undoLines.ts: one line for the whole undo, named by the step's label). Read by tests/test_moodboard_undo_lines_parity.py and frontend/tests/moodboardUndoLinesParity.test.ts. Each case's `skipped` is the entries as the backend sends them (the keys the Studio reads); `backendLines` is the backend's message for each entry in order; `studioLine` is the Studio's one line, or null when the Studio keeps the server's line under 'Undid'. The two are meant to differ where the backend has no step label (it says 'the change to image 5'), and for a kept slice the Studio does not word itself. `frameName` names the look a frame entry is about; `expect` is the value a field has now (the switch's direction); `direct` marks a line the backend can build only by calling the function with that input.
